# <a id="tag-1"></a><a id="tag-2"></a>Geomancers

### Description

Geomancers harness the power of the elements earth, air, fire and water.\
The level of their [Geomancy](skills.md#tag-60) skill gives them access to their own
[school of Geomancy](m_geoman.md), but the levels of the Fire, Water, Air, and Earth
skills will have an effect on the outcome of each spell.

Geomancers need the aid of a Mage Staff in order to use their powers.
